verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only generic IAM policies, identity domains, and billing budget alerts, but no documented multi-account/project isolation constructs (e.g., compartments, organizational units, sandbox tenancies) or guardrail patterns that explicitly separate experimental from production workloads. A community report even describes OCI deleting an entire production fleet due to a billing error, underscoring the absence of demonstrated isolation guardrails. missing for 10: documentation of compartments/org-unit hierarchy, sandbox account patterns, policy-as-guardrail examples preventing cross-environment impact, and any corroborating case of successful isolation.
